title: Add support for optionalFilters
body: This feature is still in beta but it still could be convenient to be able to set it. This is related to https://github.com/algolia/algoliasearch-helper-js/issues/200

comments.body: Since we can now pass it to searchParameters, is this solved?

Is anything happening on this? We are trying to use `optionalFilters` but it doesn't seem to be working. I noticed it located in the [algoliasearch-helper-js](https://github.com/algolia/algoliasearch-helper-js/blob/39bec1caf24a60acd042eb7bb5d7d7c719fde58b/src/SearchParameters/index.js) file? 

This repository lists `algoliasearch-helper-js` as a dependency, does instantsearch.js use helper underneath the hood? If so then I would assume it would be working.
@olance I think I could need your help to define the way widgets could use optionalFilters.

Usage of the optional filters has been tested in this example: https://jsfiddle.net/bobylito/5Lx0ea3q/

Since it's for personalization, it means that it will probably be set behind the scenes and this example shows exactly how to set it.
